import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be listed here
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        
        # Normalize column names to match target schema exactly (lowercase)
        df.columns = [col.lower() for col in df.columns]

        # Ensure columns are exactly ['user_id', 'email', 'geo']
        # If any columns are missing, add them with NaN
        for col in ['user_id', 'email', 'geo']:
            if col not in df.columns:
                df[col] = pd.NA

        # Select only the target columns in the correct order
        df = df[['user_id', 'email', 'geo']]

        # Normalize user_id to lowercase to match target examples style (e.g. user_943)
        df['user_id'] = df['user_id'].astype(str).str.lower()

        # Append to list
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Export the combined dataframe to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
